nesnd_jp_politics_reason.zh: 丰臣氏平定日本以后，朝廷的名分、诸藩的兵马和大阪的商业共同支撑着幕府的统治。新的财源与知识正在改变旧有的权力关系，商人、军官和读书人都希望参与国家的决断。围绕官员任用、军队和法令的争论，已经关系到政府将由谁来掌握。
nesnd_jp_politics_reason.en: After the Toyotomi unified Japan, the authority of the court, the armies of the domains and the commerce of Osaka sustained the shogunate. New wealth and learning are changing these relationships. Merchants, officers and scholars seek a greater say in government, challenging the old arrangements for appointing officials, commanding troops and making laws.

nesnd_jp_court_reform_reason.zh: 君主的名义仍能召集旧臣，也能为新学和商业开路。拥护改制的人们希望由熟悉实务的官员治理地方，让议政的代表参与国事，再以学校与铁路联通远近。王朝将在这些改变中重新取得人们的信任。
nesnd_jp_court_reform_reason.en: The crown can still rally old loyalties and give learning and commerce room to grow. Reformers seek capable officials in the provinces and representatives who can take part in public affairs. Schools and railways would connect distant communities, allowing the dynasty to renew its hold on public confidence.

nesnd_jp_military_reform_reason.zh: 军官们把军队视为国家最可靠的支柱。他们要求将征募、训练与军需交给统一的指挥，使地方的兵力能够供国家调度。兵工厂和工具厂将为这支军队提供装备，集中的政令则让军府有机会把自己的主张推行到各地。
nesnd_jp_military_reform_reason.en: The officers regard the army as the country’s most dependable institution. They seek common control over recruitment, training and supplies, bringing provincial forces under national direction. Arsenals and tool workshops would equip this army, while a concentrated government could carry the officers’ programme into the provinces.

nesnd_jp_representative_reform_reason.zh: 读书人讨论国政，商人关心税赋，地方居民也希望有人替自己说话。代议派要把这些议论带进议会，以选举决定代表，以公开辩论约束执政者。教育的普及将使更多国人能够读懂法令、参与公共事务。
nesnd_jp_representative_reform_reason.en: Scholars debate public affairs, merchants watch taxation, and local communities seek someone to speak for them. Advocates of representative government would bring these concerns into an elected assembly and subject those in power to open debate. Wider education can allow more people to understand the laws and take part in public life.

nesnd_jp_nation_reason.zh: 日本的诸政权长久在大陆王朝的庇护与干预下生存。自行决定国事，需要能够保卫疆土的军队、供养国家的工商业，也需要通向海外的港口与商路。我们要把这些力量掌握在自己手中，使独立有长久的根基。
nesnd_jp_nation_reason.en: Japan’s governments have long lived with protection and intervention from the mainland. To govern our own affairs, we need forces that can defend our territory, industry that can sustain the state, and ports connecting us with overseas markets. Bringing these strengths into our own hands will give independence lasting foundations.

nesnd_jp_new_army_reason.zh: 旧日军队依靠世袭武士与地方关系维持，征募和训练也随各家而异。国家需要有组织的兵员、受过训练的军官和能够听从统一调度的部队。无论以常备军还是国民军承担防务，都应使军事服务于共同的国事。
nesnd_jp_new_army_reason.en: Hereditary warriors and local loyalties sustained the old armies, with recruitment and training varying between domains. The country needs organized manpower, trained officers and forces that answer to a common command. Whether defence rests on a standing army or a national militia, military service must support the affairs of the nation.

nesnd_jp_open_diplomacy_reason.zh: 过去的朝贡和海禁把外交、通商交织在宗主的安排之中。我们需要以本国的名义派遣商船、开放港口，同其他国家商谈彼此的利益。持续的自主将使这些往来有一个可以信赖的政府作为依托。
nesnd_jp_open_diplomacy_reason.en: Tributary ties and maritime restrictions once placed diplomacy and trade within an overlord’s arrangements. We need to open our ports, send out merchant ships and negotiate with other countries in our own name. Lasting sovereignty will give these exchanges a government they can rely upon.

nesnd_jp_open_ports_reason.zh: 日本的海外买卖长久受制于少数口岸和严密的禁令。商人希望取得远方的原料，也希望把本国的出产运往更广阔的市场。政府必须决定如何开放这些海路，以及关税将在新的贸易中保护谁的利益。
nesnd_jp_open_ports_reason.en: Japan’s overseas trade has long been confined by a few designated ports and strict prohibitions. Merchants seek distant raw materials and wider markets for the country’s produce. The government must decide how to open these sea routes and whose interests its tariffs will serve.

nesnd_jp_islands_reason.zh: 本州已经归于一统，九州与四国的归属仍未完全解决。两岛的港口和海路关系着日本南部的贸易与防务。政府可以设法收回尚在他人掌握中的土地，也可以接受现有边界，放下这场领土争端。
nesnd_jp_islands_reason.en: Honshu has been reunited, but the question of Kyushu and Shikoku remains unsettled. Their ports and sea routes matter to trade and defence in southern Japan. The government may seek the remaining territories or accept the existing borders and relinquish its claims.

nesnd_jp_choose_court_desc.zh:
王朝的号召力可以把旧臣与改制者召到一处。保留君主，任用新官员，让议政与实业为国家带来新的力量。

选定后 #v 12#! 个月内不能改换方针。改换方针将清空已有改革进度。
nesnd_jp_choose_court_desc.en:
The dynasty can bring loyal retainers and reformers together. Preserve the crown, appoint capable officials, and give representative deliberation and enterprise a place in the state.

The policy cannot be changed for #v 12#! months. Changing policy resets reform progress.

nesnd_jp_choose_military_desc.zh:
军队需要统一的指挥，国家也需要能够贯彻到底的政令。支持军官们整顿兵制与军需，把地方的人力和财力用于共同的防务。

选定后 #v 12#! 个月内不能改换方针。改换方针将清空已有改革进度。
nesnd_jp_choose_military_desc.en:
The army needs a common command, and the state needs orders that can be carried through. Back the officers in reorganizing recruitment and supply, drawing provincial manpower and revenues into a common defence.

The policy cannot be changed for #v 12#! months. Changing policy resets reform progress.

nesnd_jp_choose_representative_desc.zh:
国事关乎所有纳税、服役和谋生的人。让更多代表参与议政，使官员必须面对公开的讨论，也使国民能够以选票影响政府。

选定后 #v 12#! 个月内不能改换方针。改换方针将清空已有改革进度。
nesnd_jp_choose_representative_desc.en:
Public affairs concern everyone who pays taxes, serves or earns a living. Bring more representatives into government, subject officials to public debate, and let voters influence the conduct of the state.

The policy cannot be changed for #v 12#! months. Changing policy resets reform progress.

nesnd_jp_advance_reform_desc.zh: 拨款支持主张改制的人士，让他们的议论更快成为国家的法令。
nesnd_jp_advance_reform_desc.en: Fund the advocates of reform so that their proposals can more quickly become law.

nesnd_jp_abandon_reform_desc.zh: 撤回当前改革方针，结束政府为新政进行的动员。改革进度归零，#v 24#! 个月内不能重新提出改革；已有法律和建设保留。
nesnd_jp_abandon_reform_desc.en: Withdraw the current programme and end the government’s reform campaign. Reform progress is lost, and reforms cannot be proposed again for #v 24#! months. Existing laws and buildings remain.

nesnd_jp_mercantile_ports_desc.zh: 准许商人经营海外买卖，以关税维护国家的收入和本国商业的地位。
nesnd_jp_mercantile_ports_desc.en: Allow merchants to trade overseas, using tariffs to support state revenue and domestic commerce.

nesnd_jp_protected_ports_desc.zh: 开放海路，让工场取得所需的原料，再以关税扶持本国生产者在新市场中的地位。
nesnd_jp_protected_ports_desc.en: Open the sea routes to obtain the materials our factories need, while using tariffs to support domestic producers in the wider market.

nesnd_jp_islands_settlement_desc.zh: 放弃对九州与四国的领土要求，承认目前的疆界。
nesnd_jp_islands_settlement_desc.en: Relinquish our territorial claims to Kyushu and Shikoku and accept the current borders.

nesnd_jp_court_policy.zh: 以君主名义推行宪政改革。
nesnd_jp_court_policy.en: Constitutional reform proceeds under the crown.

nesnd_jp_military_policy.zh: 集中政令，整顿军制与军需。
nesnd_jp_military_policy.en: Centralize authority and reorganize the army and its supplies.

nesnd_jp_representative_policy.zh: 扩大代议，保障公开议政。
nesnd_jp_representative_policy.en: Expand representation and protect public debate.

nesnd_jp_unsettled_policy.zh: 政府尚未决定改革的方向。
nesnd_jp_unsettled_policy.en: The government has yet to choose a course for reform.

nesnd_jp_nation_subject.zh: 国家重归藩属，对外事务受宗主约束。
nesnd_jp_nation_subject.en: The country is a subject again, with foreign affairs constrained by its overlord.

nesnd_jp_nation_independent.zh: 国家可以自主处理内外事务。
nesnd_jp_nation_independent.en: The country governs its own domestic and foreign affairs.

nesnd_jp_reform_settled.zh: 改革进度已满，且所选方针的制度目标已连续满足 #v 12#! 个月
nesnd_jp_reform_settled.en: Reform progress is full, and the chosen policy’s institutional goals have been met for #v 12#! consecutive months

nesnd_jp_nation_complete.zh: 产业、军制与外交建设均已完成，且国家已连续保持独立 #v 12#! 个月
nesnd_jp_nation_complete.en: Industrial, military and diplomatic development is complete, and the country has remained independent for #v 12#! consecutive months

nesnd_jp_independent_state.en: The Standing of an Independent State

nesnd_jp_development.1.d.zh: 军队经过整顿，工商业有了新的根基，海外往来也逐渐摆脱旧日朝贡的束缚。这些变化使独立成为人们生活中可以感受到的事实：军人听从本国的号令，商船以本国的名义出海，政府能够自行处理国事。曾经必须送往宗主朝廷的决定，如今可以在国内作出。
nesnd_jp_development.1.d.en: The army has been reorganized, industry has gained firmer foundations, and overseas commerce has moved beyond the old tributary restrictions. Independence now has a place in daily life: soldiers answer to their own government, merchant ships sail in their country’s name, and public affairs are decided at home. Decisions once referred to an overlord can now be made here.

nesnd_jp_development.1.a.en: We shall decide our own affairs.

nesnd_jp_development.2.d.zh: 新的任官办法已经推行，国家的法令也改变了权力在各阶层间的分配。旧日凭借门第把持地方的人，如今必须面对由政府确定的职位和权限；参与改制的官员、军人和商人，则在新的秩序中寻找自己的位置。这场改革已经进入日常统治，成为处理国事的准则。
nesnd_jp_development.2.d.en: New arrangements for appointing officials are in place, and the laws have changed how power is distributed. Families accustomed to holding local office by birth must now contend with positions and powers defined by the state. Officials, soldiers and merchants who took part in reform are finding their places within these arrangements, which now guide the conduct of public affairs.

nesnd_japan_reunification_reason.zh: 海峡两岸的盟约曾替丰臣打开平定诸侯的道路，也让唐土朝廷得以介入日本的继承、封地和征战。城下町的税赋汇往各家府库，军队与商人各认其主。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]要重建统一的政府，就须使本州归于一统，并取得自主决定内外政务的地位。
nesnd_japan_reunification_reason.en: Alliances across the strait once helped the Toyotomi conquer their rivals and allowed the mainland court to intervene in Japan’s successions, domains and wars. Taxes, armies and commerce now follow competing authorities. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must reunite Honshu and secure the freedom to govern its own affairs.

nesnd_japan_reunification_status.zh: 统一本州，确立自主的政府。
nesnd_japan_reunification_status.en: Unite Honshu under an independent government.

nesnd_japan_reunification_goal.zh: 独立并完整拥有本州七地区：关东、京都、关西、中国、东海、东北与北陆信越。
nesnd_japan_reunification_goal.en: Be independent and fully own Honshu’s seven regions: Kanto, Kyoto, Kansai, Chugoku, Tokai, Tohoku and Hokushinetsu.
